entries.clue: Leisurely seafront stroll, or the long paved strip you take it along.
Short-handled digging blade: plastic on the beach, steel in the garden.
Three-legged perch that keeps a long night shot rock steady
Curved single-edged blade worn slung with its cutting edge upward
Blind that flicks open for a split instant, then seals out the light
Long heavy barrel that hauls a distant bird right into the frame
Rectangle of terry cloth to lie on, dry off with, then shake out for hours
Dagger, not a sword: the smallest steel a warrior carried
Wide waist sash tied in an elaborate knot behind
Wave-polished little find, pocketed on the walk home or skimmed if it is flat.
School of Buddhism prizing silent seated meditation over scripture
